checksums.name: header_sum16_negated
checksums.formula_detail: RAM image (reverse each 8-byte file block): stored u16_le at RAM header+0x1E = (-sum of the other 15 u16_le words) mod 2^16; equivalently sum of all 16 words == 0. On file the stored word appears big-endian at 0x18 due to EEPROM block reversal. Computed by FUN_08035730-style accumulation in FUN_08035754/FUN_08035670, validated by FUN_080357ac.

checksums.name: slot_sum16_negated
checksums.formula_detail: Sum of all 60 u16_le words over the 120-byte RAM slot must be 0 (FUN_08035730 with count 0x78 in FUN_08035628); checksum word written as negated sum by the unrecovered slot writer, hypothesised as last word RAM slot+0x76 which maps to file bytes 144-145 (slot 0) via block reversal. Additionally u16 at slot+0x66 must be in 0x1F..0x84. Both samples have all-zero slots so sum is trivially 0; code-confirmed only.

io_driver_functions.notes: EEPROM size select; called with 4 at boot. Parameter sets behind unresolved literals.
EEPROM type select, always index 2 in save paths; fails for index >3.
DMA3 transfer engine: writes src/dst/count|0x80000000 to DMA3 regs (0x040000D4 group) and busy-waits on the enable bit.
EEPROM DMA interrupt setup for write completion.
EEPROM DMA interrupt teardown after write.
Reads one 8-byte EEPROM block from 0x0D000000 via DMA3; builds address bitstream, reassembles four u16 MSB-first and stores them backwards, causing per-block byte reversal in the .sav.
Writes one 8-byte EEPROM block to 0x0D000000 via DMA3 bitstream (data+address+stop bits), then polls EEPROM busy bit.
Verify: reads block back with FUN_08045dbc and compares 4 u16; returns 0 on match, 0x8000 on mismatch.
Block read wrapper: loops FUN_08045dbc, RAM +=8, block +=1.
Block write wrapper: loops FUN_08045e6c + FUN_08045f48 verify per 8-byte block. Only traced call sites are (0,0x40) format and (0,4) header flush.
Generic sum16 over byte_count/2 u16_le values; also open-coded inside FUN_08035754 and FUN_080357ac.
Header validator: reads blocks (0,4), requires sum16==0 and 8-byte magic match at RAM header+0 (LORGBA03 in RAM order, 30ABGROL on file).
Format: copies default 32-byte header template, fixes checksum, writes zeroed 512-byte image (0x40 blocks); erases all slots.
Header flush: recomputes checksum at RAM+0x1E and writes 4 blocks only if it differs from the on-EEPROM checksum.
Loads one 120-byte slot (15 blocks) from the start block in the u16 table behind _DAT_080356e8.
Slot validator: sum60==0 and u16 at slot+0x66 in 0x1F..0x84; returns low byte of that word or 0.
Loads slots 0..3 into RAM array with stride 0x78, validating each with FUN_08035628.
Mutates RAM header before flush: +0x10 = live settings byte from FUN_0803ea18, +0x11 = 1.
Boot save init: size/type select, validate header, format if invalid, apply header+0x10 via FUN_0803e9f8, load all slots. Top caller hidden behind unrecovered jumptable.

fields.name: magic
fields.update_mechanism: Written once from the default header template by the format path FUN_08035754; never updated by the header flush. RAM order after EEPROM block reversal is LORGBA03 at header+0x00.
fields.evidence: FUN_080357ac compares 8 RAM bytes after sum check; both .sav files contain 30ABGROL at file 0x00; transform proven by checksum in Section 4 of SAVE-FORMAT-REPORT.md.

fields.name: header_template_const_0c
fields.update_mechanism: Constant from default template; no traced writer modifies it after format. Covered by header checksum.
fields.evidence: Identical non-zero bytes in both samples at file 0x08-0x0B; no field-specific reader found, checksum-only.

fields.name: header_reserved_08
fields.update_mechanism: Zero in template; no traced updater. RAM header+0x08..0x0B.
fields.evidence: Zero in both samples; no writer/reader beyond checksum.

fields.name: header_settings_byte
fields.update_mechanism: FUN_08035658 copies live byte from FUN_0803ea18 (*_DAT_0803ea20) into RAM header+0x10 before flush; file offset 0x17 via block reversal. At boot FUN_0803557c applies it through FUN_0803e9f8 as a value*4 table index.
fields.evidence: FUN_08035658/FUN_0803557c/FUN_0803e9f8 bodies in ghidra/decompiled.c. Locale/language meaning is hypothesis only; value 0 in both samples.

fields.name: header_flag_11
fields.update_mechanism: FUN_08035658 writes 1 to RAM header+0x11 before every traced header flush (FUN_08025f88 chain); format template leaves it 0. File offset 0x16 via block reversal; packet mutation probe targeted this byte.
fields.evidence: Only differing payload byte between the two samples; checksum changes by exact compensating -0x0100 in RAM word terms. FUN_08035658 sets it to 1.

fields.name: header_reserved_12
fields.update_mechanism: No traced writer; RAM header+0x12..0x17, checksum-covered only.
fields.evidence: Zero in both samples; no field writer in ghidra/decompiled.c.

fields.name: header_checksum
fields.update_mechanism: Recomputed as negated sum16 of the other 15 header words whenever FUN_08035754 formats or FUN_08035670 flushes; stored at RAM header+0x1E, appearing big-endian at file 0x18-0x19 via block reversal.
fields.evidence: Python computed f515/f415 matches stored in both files; see checksums[0].

fields.name: header_reserved_18
fields.update_mechanism: Zero in template; RAM header+0x18..0x1D, checksum-covered only.
fields.evidence: Zero in both samples; no field writer traced.

fields.name: slot_validator_word
fields.update_mechanism: Offset given for slot 0 (file 0x80); add 120 per slot. In RAM it is slot+0x66 u16_le and must be 0x1F..0x84 for FUN_08035628 to accept the slot; its low byte is the validator return value. Populating writer not recovered.

open_questions: Slot writer not found: no FUN_08035838 call writes 15 blocks at a slot start in the 255 traced functions. It may dispatch through an unrecovered jumptable/function pointer or live outside the traced set.
Exact EEPROM block numbers for slots are behind the unresolved u16 table at _DAT_080356e8; sequential 4,19,34,49 is a geometric hypothesis that fits 64 blocks exactly.

Absolute RAM base addresses (0x02xxxxxx/0x03xxxxxx) for the header struct and slot array are unrecoverable because every _DAT_ literal in this Ghidra export is unresolved; only struct offsets are known.
Slot checksum word position inside the 120-byte record is not isolated (blank samples, missing writer); last-word (+0x76) is analogy only.
Meaning of header template bytes RAM+0x0C..0x0F (07 FF D4 00), the settings byte at RAM+0x10 (locale hypothesis), and the flag at RAM+0x11 beyond being set to 1 on flush.
Gameplay trigger and the *_DAT_08025fc4 condition guarding the FUN_08025f88 header-flush branch, plus the indirect boot caller of FUN_0803557c, are hidden behind unrecovered jumptables.
Whether FUN_080355c0's slot retry loop ever retries: as decompiled its counter starts at 0, giving one effective attempt per slot.
No generation/sequence counter or redundant copy was found; whether populated slots encode one internally cannot be tested on blank samples.
